Fitting and installing replacement property is excluded under 7.1.8(c).

items.rationale: Bundles a liability risk and a service arrangement without separate pricing; excluded under 3.1.4, 3.1.5 and 7.1.8(f).
Charge for placing an order under a service arrangement is excluded under 3.1.5 and 7.1.8(f).
Under 7.1.8(d) an attendance charge is not indemnifiable where the work on the same invoice is not indemnifiable.
